# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in improving this project. For significant changes,
open an issue first to discuss the proposed approach.

## Development

- Keep changes focused and maintain the existing Go style.
- Add or update tests for behaviour changes.
- Run `gofmt -w` on changed Go files.
- Run `go test -race ./...` and `go vet ./...` before opening a pull request.

## Pull requests

Describe the problem and solution, link any related issue, and mention the
checks you ran. Keep each pull request focused on one change.
